title: PWR-A SHRINK-2 placement probe: 235 refs at the planned positions (both sides) and the scripted copper of the SHRINK-2 spec
note: W2 PCB-PWRA-3 probe for one CI route run (generated by build/kicad/boards/PWR_A/make_probe_spec.py from PWR_A.spec-shrink2.json and placement-study-shrink2.json): every ref the board_gen planner placed is anchored at its planned origin, so that KiCad 10.0.7 checks the placement (courtyards on both sides), the J208 mate against PWR_B J209 and the THT pockets on a saved board, and Freerouting routes it once. Left out (10): refs with a pending planned footprint (C111, C112, C219, C225, L202, L204, L211, L212, L213, L214) and the reserved blocks of pending changes, so the domain and boundary audits fail by construction; removed from pcb/boards/ right after the run.

layers.source: build/15 'Шари' and 'Мідь і струмові класи (W2 PCB-RULES)': JLC04161H-7628, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, no 2 oz

plan.F.Cu: L1: parts, signals; BATT/PWR3A pours (scripted where both ends are anchored)
plan.In1.Cu: L2: solid GND (post-route pour over the whole outline)
plan.In2.Cu: L3: GND fill (pre-route plane) until the placement-dependent power pours take their areas (higher priority)
plan.B.Cu: L4: signals; BATT/PWR3A pours paired with L1; GND bond copper in the four thermal_bond zones, solder mask on

layers.types_why: layer type power on both inner layers and a pre-route GND plane on each (as PWR_B): the DSN then carries the planes and Freerouting puts only vias through them. Probe 2 (sr-rx-pcb run 42424071774) and probe 3 (run 42424538187, layer type alone) routed LAB5, E1_N, E1_SHUNT_P and E1_LAB5_FUSED tracks on In1/In2, which the classes do not count (17 check_boards class_widths findings) and which cut the L2 GND plane. L3 power pours (layer plan) go in later as higher-priority zones inside the L3 GND fill

rules_note: board_gen refuses rules_file until it copies and hashes it (PCB-FAB/PCB-SB1 lineage), so the net classes and project rules of pcb/rules/jlc-4l-1oz.kicad_dru and pcb/generated/netclasses.json are mirrored in PWR_A.kicad_pro: classes SIG (Default) 0.15, PWR1A 0.35, PWR2A 0.8, PWR3A 1.85, BATT 3.2 mm outer, clearance 0.15; via 0.6/0.3; min through hole 0.2 because the KiCad LT3045 footprint MSOP-12-1EP ThermalVias drills 0.2 mm (JLC 4-layer floor 0.15)

zones.why: L2 solid GND (layer plan W2 PCB-RULES) as a pre-route plane: a plane in the DSN keeps the router off In1; the THT GND pins and the EP vias join it
L3 GND fill (pre-route plane, as PWR_B In2): keeps the router off In2; the placement-dependent L3 power pours replace it locally as higher-priority zones

post_route_zones.why: GND copper on L4 over contract thermal_bond zone 1/2, extended to y 0.6 under the bottom header row (W2 PCB-PWRA-2: probe 1 had starved_thermal on J108.1 at the zone edge y 4); mask on
GND copper on L4 over contract thermal_bond zone 1/2, extended to y 0.6 under the bottom header row (W2 PCB-PWRA-2: probe 1 had starved_thermal on J108.1 at the zone edge y 4); mask on
GND copper on L4 over thermal_bond zone 3 (SHRINK-2 converter zone); mask on
GND copper on L4 over thermal_bond zone 4 (SHRINK-2 converter zone); mask on

height_zones.why: parts taller than hA 4.5 need a PWR-B window (pcb/partition-spec.json height_rule); the window list of this placement is in placement-study.json pwr_b_cutouts

router.why: fanout false as on PWR_B: the Freerouting 2.5.0 fan-out pre-pass escaped SMD pins with 0.1124 mm stubs (PWR_A probe run 42413833702: 20 track_width + 6 connection_width; PWR_B run 42414083566)

warning_checks.footprint_filters_mismatch: schematic-parity check; per-board PCBs are not linked to the multi-sheet schematic, so DRC runs without --schematic-parity and the source-pad audit replaces it
warning_checks.missing_tuning_profile: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.tuning_profile_track_geometries: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.generic_warning: KiCad's catch-all warning class; any instance is listed in report.json and reviewed
warning_checks.silk_over_copper: legend only: the fab clips legend over exposed copper; every instance is listed in report.json and reviewed (library footprints whose legend crosses their own pads)
warning_checks.silk_overlap: legend only: overlapping legend items are cosmetic; every instance is listed in report.json

tht_pockets_note: proposed plate relief pockets (M-07) = THT pads and NPTH pegs of each placed top part + 1.0 mm (mechanical/params/boards.json tht_pockets margin), rounded outward to 0.05 mm; margin boxes less than 3 mm apart share one pocket (make_probe_spec.py RIB)
